phases.name: Live delta, stale-state cleanup and seal

major_conclusions: Last night's Core, Learning, Book and Prose work is preserved as repository evidence and was not dismissed, rolled back or replayed merely because the original Second Shift controller stopped early.
The overnight execution defect was an orchestration/control defect, not proof that completed owner-lane product work was invalid.
The complete historical product inventory contains 40 module rows; DATA, PHONEOPS and PHYSICALAI were omitted from the prose enumeration but recovered from the master index and reconciled in P6.
All 211 branch refs were classified in P7 without allowing branch/workstream/qualification names to create architecture; no executable orphan branch authority remained unexplained.
Shared registries were reconciled in P8 using newest owner-valid evidence instead of mechanically replaying stale deltas.
P9 repaired stale Second Shift live selectors and the schema/topology defects exposed by repository-wide enforcement while preserving all prior selector history.
System Master is not product-complete. The census is complete: it now truthfully identifies current completion evidence, open obligations, ownership gaps and authority boundaries.

control_evidence.post_seal_rule: Every later governance/authority write remains subject to fresh automatic gates. A later red result is a new drift signal and does not erase this exact historical PASS.

current_open_work_rule: Use governance/WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-002.json for current open work. Use Registry 001 and completion/evidence records for historical closed/superseded lineage. Do not rebuild closed phases because a new chat starts.
central_next_objective_reason: Resolve the largest remaining product-root architecture gap by defining the smallest non-duplicative semantic owner-contract portfolio for headless tools over Core shared infrastructure. This must preserve CORE/LEARNING/BOOK/PROSE topology, avoid one-system-per-tool proliferation, preserve headless-first interaction, and provide lawful current admission paths for preserved document/spreadsheet/code/research/media evidence.
resume_rule: Do not restart SYSTEM-MASTER-COMPLETION-CENSUS-002. Read CURRENT-AUTHORITY, SYSTEM-STATE-BASELINE-003 and WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-002. Reconcile any live owner-head delta since this seal, then continue the central next objective or the requested owner lane. Reopen a census phase only if specific durable evidence proves its sealed result invalid.
authority_boundary: The final seal transfers no exact-SHA PASS and fabricates no human, author, private, blind, A-01, native, publication or production authority. It seals repository truth and next-work routing only.
